action.objective: Capture the b3 pawn with the a-pawn, activating the queen and maintaining material advantage.
action.rationale: a2b3 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 4 with exact score 890, safety.complete true, tactical_refutation not_found, and PV axb3 h6 Bh4.
